claims: April 15, 2026 is the last day to file or request an extension without penalty.
An automatic six-month extension is available until October 15, 2026.
The automatic six-month extension is requested by filing Form 4868 electronically or via IRS online payment options.
An extension gives more time to file paperwork.
An extension does not give more time to pay any taxes owed.
If money is owed and not paid by April 15, 2026, interest will accrue.
If money is owed and not paid by April 15, 2026, late payment penalties will potentially apply.
